senses.gloss: पुर् f. 1. A town, a fortified town, a fortress, पूरप्यभिव्यक्तमुखप्रसादा R.xvi.23; 2. a wall, a rampart; 3. body; 4. intellect.
पूर् (I) vt. 4Ā (pp. पूर्ण; pres. पूर्यते) 1. To fill, to fill out; 2. to please, to satisfy.

पूर् (II) vt. 10U (pp. पूरित; pres. पूरयति-ते) 1. To fill, to fill out, माथुरस्य पांशुना चक्षुषी पूरयित्वा Mrich.ii.; 2. to fill with wind, to blow; 3. to cover, to surround, Bt.vii.30; 4. to fill with sound, to make resonant; 5. to intensify, to strengthen.With आ-, 1. to fill, to fill up, to make full, R.xvi.65, Bg.xi.30; 2. to blow, to fill with wind; 3. to cover, to envelop, to intertwine, (केशान्) आपूरयंति वनिता नवमालतीभिः Rt.iii.18.With परि-, to fill, to fill completely.With प्र-, 1. to fill; 2. to enrich, to load with riches.With सम्-, to fill.
पुरंदर m. 1. an epithet of Indra, R.ii.74; 2. an epithet of Śiva; 3. of Agni; 4. a thief, a house-breaker.
पुरंदरा f. an epithet of the Ganges.
पूर्द्वार् f. the gate of a city.
पूर्द्वार n. the gate of a city.
पुरिशय a. reposing in a fortress.

पुर n. 1. A town, a city (surrounded by a ditch and extending not less than one Koś in length), पुरंदरश्रीः पुरमुत्पताकम् R.ii.74, i.59, M.vii.70; 2. a fortress, a castle; 3. a house, a residence; 4. the body; 5. a name of Pāṭalīputra q.v.; 6. the female apartments; 7. a brothel; 8. the skin; 9. the cup of a flower.

पुरा ind. 1. In former times, of yore, पुरा शक्रमुपस्थाय तवोर्वीं प्रति यास्यतः R.i.75, M.i.199; 2. continually, hitherto; 3. in the first place, at first; 4. in a short time, ere long, (in this sense, it gives a future sense to the present tense, आलोके ते निपतति पुरा Megh.ii.22, or पुरा दूषयति स्थलीम् R.xii.30, Na.i.18).
पुरा f. 1. An epithet of the Ganges; 2. a kind of perfume; 3. the east.
पूर (I) m. 1. Satisfying, making content; 2. filling; 3. supply, K.S.i.10; 4. swelling of a river or of the sea, R.iv.17; 5. a stream, a flood; 6. a kind of cake; 7. the healing of wounds.
पूर (II) n. A kind of incense.
पुर-अट्ट m. a turret on a city-wall.
पुरट n. Gold.
पुर-अधिप m. the governor of a town.
पुर-अराति, -अरि, -असुहृद् m. an epithet of Śiva. See त्रिपुर.
पुर-अराति, -अरि, -असुहृद् m. an epithet of Śiva. See त्रिपुर.
पुर-अराति, -अरि, -असुहृद् m. an epithet of Śiva. See त्रिपुर.
पुर-उत्सव m. a festival held in a city.
पुर-उद्यान n. a city-garden, a park.
पुर-ओकस् m. an inhabitant of a town.
पुर-कोट्ट n. citadel.
पुर-जित्, -द्विष्, -भिद् m. an epithet of Śiva.
पुर-जित्, -द्विष्, -भिद् m. an epithet of Śiva.
पुर-जित्, -द्विष्, -भिद् m. an epithet of Śiva.
पुर-ज्योतिस् m. an epithet of fire.
पुर-तटी f. a small market-town.
पुर-तोरण n. the outer gate of a city.
पुर-द्वार n. a city-gate.
पुर-निवेश m. the founding of a city.
पुर-पाल m. the commandant of a fortress.
पुर-मथन m. an epithet of Śiva.
पुर-मार्ग m. the street of a town, R.xi.3.
पुर-रक्ष, -रक्षक, -रक्षिन् m. a constable.
पुर-रक्ष, -रक्षक, -रक्षिन् m. a constable.
पुर-रक्ष, -रक्षक, -रक्षिन् m. a constable.
पुर-रोध m. the siege of a fortress.
पुर-वासिन् m. a citizen, a townsman.
पुर-शासन m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. of Śiva.
पुरग a. (f. गा) Favourably inclined.
पुरग a. (f. गा) Favourably inclined.
पुरण m. The sea.
पुराण (I) a. (f. णा or णी) 1. Ancient, old, belonging to olden times, पुराणमित्येव न साधु सर्वं न चापि काव्यं नवमित्यवद्यम् Mal.i., or अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणः Bg.ii.20; 2. worn out.

पुराण (II) n. 1. A past event; 2. any legendary tale; 3. the name of a certain class of sacred works ascribed to Vyāsa and containing the whole body of Hindu mythology.(पुराण is thus defined- सर्गश्च प्रतिसर्गश्च वंशो मन्वंतराणि च । वंशानुचरितं चैव पुराणं पंचलक्षणम्. There are eighteen principal Purāṇas- अश्ग्टादशपुराणानि पुराणज्ञः प्रचक्षते । ब्राह्मं पाद्मं वैष्णवं च शैवं भागवतं तथा । तथान्यन्नारदीयं च मार्कंडेयं च सप्तमम् । आग्नेयमष्टमं चैव भविष्यं नवमं स्मृतम् । वाराहं द्वादशं चैव स्कांदं चैव त्रयोदशम् । चतुर्दशं वामनं च कौर्मं पंचदशं स्मृतम् । मात्स्यं च गारुडं चैव ब्रह्मांडं च ततः परम्.)
पुराण (III) m. A coin equal to eighty cowries.
पुराण (I) a. (f. णा or णी) 1. Ancient, old, belonging to olden times, पुराणमित्येव न साधु सर्वं न चापि काव्यं नवमित्यवद्यम् Mal.i., or अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणः Bg.ii.20; 2. worn out.
पूरण (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Filling up, completing; (the word is applied in this sense to ordinal numbers, such as द्वितीय, तृतीय &c.), e.g. न पूरणी तं समुपैति संख्या; 2. satisfying.
पूरण (II) m. 1. A bridge, a causeway; 2. the ocean.
पूरण (III) n. 1. Filling, filling up, completing, R.ix.73; 2. puffing, swelling; 3. fulfilling; 4.; 5. a sort of cake; 6. a funeral cake; 7. wart; 8. multiplication (in math.).
पुरतस् ind. 1. Before, in front, in the presence of, e.g. पत्या पुरतः सरता; 2. afterwards, प्रारब्धा पुरतो यथा मनसिजस्याज्ञा तथा वर्तितुम् Am.S.43.
पुरंध्रि(ध्री) f. 1. An elderly married woman, K.S.vi.32, vii.2; 2. a woman whose husband and children are living, R.vii.28.
पुरंध्रि(ध्री) f. 1. An elderly married woman, K.S.vi.32, vii.2; 2. a woman whose husband and children are living, R.vii.28.
पुरला f. An epithet of Durgā.

पुरस् ind. 1. Before, in front, in the presence of, (with a gen.), तावंत्येव कृतागसो द्रुततरं व्याहृत्य पत्युः पुरः Am.S.43, R.ii.36, Megh.i.3, K.S.iv.3 (in this sense it is often prefixed to कृ, भू and गम्; hence such forms as पुरस्कृत्य &c.); 2. in the east, from the east, eastward.
पुरस्-करण n. 1. placing in front; 2. treating with honour, deference; 3. preference; 4. accompanying, attending; 5. preparing, making ready; 6. accusation.
पुरस्-कार m. 1. placing in front; 2. treating with honour, deference; 3. preference; 4. accompanying, attending; 5. preparing, making ready; 6. accusation.
पुरस्-कृत a. 1. placed in front, R.ii.120; 2. chosen, adopted, R.viii.9; 3. accompanied by, attended by; 4. honoured, distinguished; 5. prepared; 6. accused, calumniated; 7. consecrated.
पुरस्-क्रिया f. 1. a preparatory rite; 2. showing respect.
पुरोग a. leading, chief, preeminent, K.S.vii.40 (used as a noun also, R.vi.55, xiv.31).
पुरोग a. leading, chief, preeminent, K.S.vii.40 (used as a noun also, R.vi.55, xiv.31).
पुरोगति (I) m. a dog.
पुरोगति (II) f. precedence.
पुरोगामिन् (I) a. leading, chief.
पुरोगामिन् (II) m. a dog.
पुरस्-चरण n. 1. an introductory rite; 2. repetition of the name of a deity accompanied by burnt offerings.
पुरस्-छद m. a nipple.
पुरोजन्मन् a. born before.
पुरोडाश् m. 1. an oblation in general; 2. a sacrificial cake of ground rice, M.vi.11.
पुरोडाश् m. 1. an oblation in general; 2. a sacrificial cake of ground rice, M.vi.11.
पुरोधस् m. a family-priest, especially that of a king.
पुरोधान n. priestly ministration.
पुरोधिका f. a favourite wife.
पुरोभाग (I) a. 1. obtrusive; 2. fault-finding, प्रायः समानविद्याः परस्परयशः पुरोभागाः Mal.i.
पुरोभाग (II) m. 1. the front part; 2. officiousness; 3. envy.
पुरस्-पाक a. having fulfilment at hand, K.S.vi.90.
पुरस्-प्रहर्तृ m. one who fights in the front line, R.xiii.72.
पुरस्-फल a. promising fruit, having fruit in the near future, R.ii.22.
पुरोभागिन् a. 1. obtrusive, officious; 2. fault-finding; 3. jealous.
पुरोमारुत m. a wind blowing in front.
पुरोमारुत m. a wind blowing in front.
पुरस्-सर (I) a. moving in front.
पुरस्-सर (II) m. 1. a servant, an attendant, मा भूदाश्रमपीडेति परिमेयपुरःसरौ R.i.37; 2. a leader, one who leads the way, K.S.vi.49.
पुरस्-स्थायिन् a. standing in front.
पुरोहित (I) a. 1. placed in front; 2. charged, commissioned.
पुरोहित (II) m. a family-priest who conducts all the ceremonials of the family.

पुरस्तात् ind. 1. In front of, before, (with gen. or abl.), K.S.vii.30, R.ii.44, Megh.i.15; 2. in the first place; 3. previously, formerly; 4. eastward, in the east, Bg.xi.40; 5. further on, in the sequel.
पुरा-उपनीत a. formerly possessed.
पुरा-कथा f. in old legend.
पुरा-कल्प m. 1. a fomier creation; 2. an old story, a story of the past, द्यूतमेतत्पुराकल्पे दृष्टं वैरकरं महत् M.ix.227.
पुरा-कृत a. done formerly.
पुरा-तन (I) a. 1. old, ancient, Bg.iv.3, K.S.vi.9; 2. worn out.
पुरा-तन (II) m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
पुरा-योनि a. of ancient origin.
पुरा-वसु m. an epithet of Bhīṣma.
पुरा-विद् a. acquainted with the past, knowing the events of former times, K.S.vi.9, R.xi.10, K.S.v.28.
पुरा-वृत्त (I) a. 1. what occurred in former times; 2. referring to times of yore.
पुरा-वृत्त (II) n. 1. historic; 2. an old or legendary event.
पुराण (I) a. (f. णा or णी) 1. Ancient, old, belonging to olden times, पुराणमित्येव न साधु सर्वं न चापि काव्यं नवमित्यवद्यम् Mal.i., or अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणः Bg.ii.20; 2. worn out.
पूरण (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Filling up, completing; (the word is applied in this sense to ordinal numbers, such as द्वितीय, तृतीय &c.), e.g. न पूरणी तं समुपैति संख्या; 2. satisfying.
पुराण-अंत m. an epithet of Yama.
पुराण-उक्त a. enjoined by the Purāṇas.
पुराण-ग m. 1. an epithet of Brahman (m.); 2. a reader of the Purāṇas.
पुराण-पुरुष m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
पुरि f. 1. A city; 2. a river.
पुरी f. 1. A city, a town, शशासैकपुरीमिव R.i.30, Megh.i.30; 2. a stronghold; 3. the body.
पुरी-मोह m. the Dhattūra plant.
पुरी-तत् m.n. 1. name of an intestine near the heart; 2. the entrails in general; (also read पुरितत, perhaps wrongly).
पुरीष n. 1. Feces, ordure, M.iv.36, iv.80, v.138; 2. rubbish, mould.
पुरीष-उत्सर्ग m. the voiding of excrement.
पुरीष-निग्रहण a. obstructing the bowels.
पुरीषण (I) m. Feces, ordure.
पुरीषण (II) n. Evacuation by stool.
पुरीषण m. The black kidney-bean.
पुरु (I) a. (f. रु or र्वी) Much, many, abundant; (in this sense, it is rarely used in classics; the Bhagavata has it in several places.)
पुरु (II) m. 1. The pollen of a flower; 2. heaven; 3. name of a son of Yayāti.
पुरु (I) a. (f. रु or र्वी) Much, many, abundant; (in this sense, it is rarely used in classics; the Bhagavata has it in several places.)
पुरु-जित् m. 1. a name of king Kuntibhoja; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
पुरु-द n. gold.
पुरु-दंशक m. a goose.
पुरु-लंपट a. very lascivious.
पुरु-ह, -हू a. much, many.
पुरु-ह, -हू a. much, many.
पुरु-हूत (I) a. invoked by many.
पुरु-हूत (II) m. an epithet of Indra, R.iv.3, K.S.vii.45.
पुरु-हूत˚द्विष् m. an epithet of Indrajit.

पुरुष (I) m. 1. Mankind; 2. a male, a man, M.vii.17, ix.2; 3. representative of a generation; 4. an official, a functionary; 5. the height of a man considered as a measure of length; 6. the soul; 7. the supreme being; 8. the pupil of the eye; 9. a person (in gram.); 10. the twenty-fifth principle of creation of the Sāṅkhyas, i.e. the soul which, according to them, is neither a production nor productive. See /Sāṅkhya K./3.
पुरुष (II) n. An epithet of mount Mem.
पूरुष m. The same as पुरुष q.v.
पुरुष-अंग m.n. the male organ of generation.
पुरुष-अद m. a demon, a goblin.
पुरुष-अधम m. a very low man, the vilest of men.
पुरुष-अधिकार m. a manly duty.
पुरुष-अंतर n. another man.
पुरुष-अर्थ m. one of the four principal objects of human existence (viz., धर्म, अर्थ, काम and मोक्ष). See under अर्थ.
पुरुष-अस्थिमालिन् m. an epithet of Śiva.
पुरुष-आद्य m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
पुरुष-आयुष्, -आयुस् n. the duration of a man’s life, पुरुषायुषजीविन्यो निरातंका निरीतयः R.i.63.
पुरुष-आयुष्, -आयुस् n. the duration of a man’s life, पुरुषायुषजीविन्यो निरातंका निरीतयः R.i.63.
पुरुष-आशिन् m. a demon, a goblin.
पुरुष-इंद्र m. a king.
पुरुष-उत्तम m. 1. an excellent man; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa (यस्मात् क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः । अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः Bg.xv.18).
पुरुष-कार m. 1. manly act, manliness, human exertion, (op. to दैव), स्वमिव पुरुषकारं शैलमभ्याससाद Kir.v.52, or दैवे पुरुषकारे च कर्मसिद्धिर्व्यवस्थिता Yaj.i.349; 2. virility, manhood.
पुरुष-कुणप m.n. a human corpse.
पुरुष-केसरिन् m. (man-lion) Viṣṇu in his fourth incarnation, पुरुषकेसरिणश्च पुरा नखैः Sak.vii.
पुरुष-ज्ञान n. knowledge of mankind.
पुरुष-ता f. virility, manliness.
पुरुष-त्व n. virility, manliness.
पुरुष-दघ्न, -द्वयस् a. of the height of a man.
पुरुष-दघ्न, -द्वयस् a. of the height of a man.
पुरुष-द्विष् m. an enemy of Viṣṇu.
पुरुष-नाथ m. 1. a general, a commander; 2. a king.
पुरुष-पशु m. a fool, a beast of a man.
पुरुष-पुंगव, -पुंडरीक m. an eminent man.
पुरुष-पुंगव, -पुंडरीक m. an eminent man.
पुरुष-बहुमान m. the esteem of mankind.
पुरुष-मेध m. a human sacrifice.
पुरुष-वर m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
पुरुष-वाह m. 1. an epithet of Garuḍa; 2. an epithet of Kubera.
पुरुष-व्याघ्र, -शार्दूल, -सिंह m. a distinguished or eminent man.
पुरुष-व्याघ्र, -शार्दूल, -सिंह m. a distinguished or eminent man.
पुरुष-व्याघ्र, -शार्दूल, -सिंह m. a distinguished or eminent man.
पुरुष-समवाय m. a number of men.
पुरुष-सूक्त n. a name given to the 90th hymn of the tenth Maṇḍala of the Ṛgveda.
पुरुषक n. Standing on two feet like a man, the rearing of a horse, श्रीवृक्षकीपुरुषकोन्नमिताग्रकायः Sis.v.66.
पुरुषायित n. 1. Manly conduct; 2. a mode of sexual enjoyment in which the woman acts the man.
पुरोटि m. 1. The current of a river; 2. the rustling of leaves.
पुर्व् vt. 1P (pres. पूर्वति) 1. To fill; 2. to dwell, to inhabit.
पूर-उत्पीड m. excess of water, Ut.iii.
पूरक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Filling up; 2. satisfying, making content.
पूरक (II) m. 1. The citron tree; 2. a cake of meal offered at the conclusion of the oblations to the Manes; 3. the multiplier (in math.).
पूरक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Filling up; 2. satisfying, making content.
पूरण-प्रत्यय m. an affix forming an ordinal.
पूरिका f. A kind of cake.
पूरित a. (f. ता) 1. Filled, complete; 2. overspread; 3. multiplied.
पूरित a. (f. ता) 1. Filled, complete; 2. overspread; 3. multiplied.
पूर्ण a. (f. र्णा) 1. Filled up, full of, M.xi.183, R.ii.12; 2. whole, entire, complete, R.iii.38; 3. fulfilled, accomplished; 4. full-sounding, sonorous; 5. strong, powerful; 6. selfish.
पूर्ण a. (f. र्णा) 1. Filled up, full of, M.xi.183, R.ii.12; 2. whole, entire, complete, R.iii.38; 3. fulfilled, accomplished; 4. full-sounding, sonorous; 5. strong, powerful; 6. selfish.
पूर्ण-अंक m. an integer.
पूर्ण-अभिलाष a. satisfied, content.
पूर्ण-आनक n. 1. a drum; 2. the sound of a drum; 3. a vessel; 4. a moon-bearn; 5. a present made to anyone who brings a good news; (in this sense the word is sometimes read पूर्णालक also).
पूर्ण-इंदु m. the full moon.
पूर्ण-उपमा f. a complete simile; (in such a simile the four requisites, namely, उपमेय, उपमान, साधारणधर्म and उपमावाचक must all be expressed. See K.Pr.x. under उपमा).
पूर्ण-ककुद् a. full-humped.
पूर्ण-काम a. satistied, satiated.
पूर्ण-कुंभ m. 1. a vessel full of water; 2. a hole of the shape of a water-jar, तदत्र पूर्णकुंभं एव शोभते Mrich.iii.; 3. a particular mode of fighting.

पूर्ण-पात्र m.n. 1. a full cup; 2. a cup-full; 3. a measure of capacity equal to 250 handfuls; 4. a vessel full of valuable things which is scrambled for by servants or relatives on occasions of joy, (हर्षादुत्सवकाले यदलंकारांशुकादिकम् । आकृष्य गृह्यते पूर्णपात्रं स्यात्पूर्णकं च तत् Jaṭādhara); 5. a present given to the bringer of good news, तत्कामं प्रभवति पूर्णपात्रवृत्त्या स्वीकर्तुं मम हृदयं च जीवितं च M.M.iv.
पूर्ण-बीज, -वीज m. a citron.
पूर्ण-बीज, -वीज m. a citron.
पूर्ण-मासी f. the day of full moon.
पूर्णक m. 1. A kind of tree; 2. a cock; 3. the blue jay.
पूर्णिमा f. The day of full moon.
पूर्णिमा f. The day of full moon.
पूर्त (I) a. (f. र्ता) 1. Full, complete; 2. concealed, covered; 3. protected.

पूर्त (II) n. 1. Fulfilment; 2. cherishing, nourishing; 3. name of a class of acts of pious liberality; (in this sense पूर्त is thus defined- वापीकूपतडागादि देवतायतनानि च । अन्नप्रदानमारामः पूर्तमित्यभिधीयते M.iv.226; in combination with इष्ट forms इष्टापूर्त q.v. इष्ट is thus defined by Atri- अग्निहोत्रं तपः सत्यं वेदानांचैव पालनम् । आतिथ्यं वैश्वदेवश्च इष्टमित्यभिधीयते).
पूर्त (I) a. (f. र्ता) 1. Full, complete; 2. concealed, covered; 3. protected.
पूर्ति f. 1. Filling; 2. completion, accomplishment; 3. satisfaction.

पूर्व (I) a. (f. र्वा) (when implying relative position in time or place, the word is declined like a pronoun but optionally so in the nom. pl. and abl. and loc. sing.) 1. Being in front of, first, foremost; 2. eastern, easterly; 3. old, ancient, अथवा कृतवाग्द्वारे वंशेऽस्मिन् पूर्वसूरिभिः R.i.4; 4. preceding, former, anterior; 5. previous to, earlier than; 6. aforesaid, before-mentioned; 7. (at the end of a compound) preceded by, attended with, accompanied by, पुण्यः शब्दो मुनिरिति मुहुः केवलं राजपूर्वः Sak.ii., दशपूर्वरथं यमाख्यया दशकंठारिगुरुं विदुर्बुधाः R.viii.29, तान् स्मितपूर्वमाह K.S.vii.47, v.31.
पूर्व (II) m. A forefather, an ancestor, पयः पूर्वैः सनिश्वासैः कवोष्णमुपभुज्यते R.i.67, v.14.

पूर्व (III) n. The forepart.[पूर्वम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘formerly,’ ‘beforehand,’ ‘antecedently,’ ‘previously,’ R.xii.35, M.ii.60, viii.205. पूर्वेण ‘to the east’ (with an acc. or gen.)]पूर्वम्-ततस् or पश्चात् ‘first-then.’ पूर्वम्-उपरि ‘previousely-subsequently.’ पूवम्-अधुना ‘formerly-now.’

पूर्व-अपर (II) n. 1. collection; 2. the proof and the thing to be proved.

पूर्वंगम a. going before, preceding.

पूर्व-पक्ष m. 1. the first half of a lunar month; 2. the first part of an argument, the prima facie view of a question; 3. the statement of the plaintiff; 4. a suit at law.

पूर्व-पाणिनीय m. pl. the disciples of Pāṇini living in the east.

पूर्व-राग m. dawning love which springs before the lovers have met.
